description: {"time": 1783112254616, "blocks": [{"id": "wr1ul7e4yj", "data": {"text": "Gangsta Limo (Square Format) \u2014 a Luminous Sacco matatu that played with the contrast between 'gangsta' grit and 'limo' luxury. The name captured the dual identity of matatus: rough-and-tumble public transport that also serves as a personal statement of style. Dennis Muraguri's 2018 woodcut isolates the most iconic elements of the livery into a balanced square crop. Luminous Sacco serves Nairobi routes with a fleet known for adventurous, boundary-pushing designs. Gangsta Limo combined hip-hop swagger with the elongated proportions of a stretch limousine \u2014 a visual joke that worked on multiple levels. Muraguri's carving preserves the humour and the artistry. The square format is perfect for modern interiors with limited wall space, framing beautifully as a standalone piece or as part of a diptych with the original uncropped composition.
